## Rule

Fixed 21x21 periodic color grids with holes (zero cells). Infer the horizontal+vertical period p by comparing nonzero cells shifted by p, picking the period with zero conflicts and the most comparisons. Fill each zero cell from the nonzero cells in the same 2D residue class `(row mod p, col mod p)`.

Full recipe: see `Research_Archive/notes/recipe-task017-periodic-hole-fill.md`.

## Algorithm sketch
Superseded v30 opset-11 grouped-conv sketch archived → `_archive/task017_history.md`. **Current best is Sho's 3963 graph** (decoded in the 2026-07-10 Attempts entry): Conv autocorr `G` + rank-5 Einsum `D` → `2·G−dd==21·(21−p)` period test → residue-onehot `P` → free Einsum fill. Canonical rule recipe: `Research_Archive/notes/recipe-task017-periodic-hole-fill.md`.

## Don't-do log

- **Cast input→f16 before Slice**: Creates 18000-byte intermediate (full [1,10,30,30] f16) vs
  current 15876+7938=23814 bytes. Saves nothing — the Slice reduction must happen FIRST.
- **F16 label-extraction Conv to halve v26_label_f32 (1764→882): IMPOSSIBLE — FALSIFIED with a hard number** (2026-06-24, Worker-W2). The 1764 B F32 `v26_label_f32` is the OUTPUT of the only node reading the official F32 `input` (a 1×1 negpad channel-collapse Conv). ONNX Conv requires X/W/Y same dtype (ort_reality §dtype-matrix; cost_floor task400 "ORT forces Conv→F32"), so an F16 Conv needs an F16 input → `Cast(input→f16)` materializes the full [1,10,30,30] F16 plane. **Built + scored the variant (`prototypes/_task017_v32_f16labelconv_probe.py`): COST 26128 (mem 25936) = +16236 WORSE.** v31 also has NO multi-channel F16 foreground intermediate to reuse (fill runs on the single 1-ch `v15_label_f16` 882 plane). The 1764 F32 read is the forced #98-minimal full-plane input read; do NOT re-walk this lever.
- **Or(Less, Greater) → Not(Equal): ALREADY DONE — lever is spent** (2026-06-11, w-D1 re-audit). The
  original opset-10 graph used `Less+Greater+Or`, but the v15→v21 SESSION-2 rewrite already moved to
  opset 11 and v18 replaced that chain with `Equal+Not`. The deployed team-best v30 graph (opset 11,
  ir 10) has `Or`=0; every period uses `Equal(color_left_f16, color_right_f16) → Not → And(both,diff)`.
  Equality is on **FLOAT16** row labels (1×21), NOT int8 — so the old "int8 Equal unsupported at
  opset10" blocker never applied to the final lineage. The remaining 7 `Less` nodes are the unrelated
  `conflicts < 0.5` (count==0 → period-valid) tests; the 1 `Greater` is the nonzero-row detector.
  Neither is a conflict OR-of-comparisons. **No ~3024 B is recoverable**: the whole conflict block runs
  on single-row 1×21 f16 tensors (~38 B each, <300 B total) — it is not a cost lever at all. The 3024 B
  estimate was against the OLD full-grid opset-10 graph, long superseded.
- **Kernel 1D decomposition**: Two grouped 1D convs require extra Reshape intermediates; net
  neutral or slightly worse than 2D grouped conv with Expand.
- **9 separate 1-channel convs**: 9×Conv intermediates = 15876 bytes vs Expand+Conv = 7938+7938.
- **Pad(mode='wrap') fundamental-tile reconstruction is hidden-UNSAFE here** (2026-06-19, Worker-A, 4000 fresh ARC-GEN): re-tiling the 21×21 from ONE extracted p×p tile via `Pad(mode='wrap')` @opset19 (the op DOES execute in ORT 1.24.4) fails because **a single fixed p×p tile has a hole in 32.8% of samples** — no fixed tile position is hole-free (5 mergeable ≤5×5 cutouts land anywhere). The full residue class is never fully holed (0/4000), so only the whole-class comb-conv average is hidden-safe; a fixed-tile wrap or Mod-Gather (#55b) reads one possibly-holed representative. Building a clean tile first re-introduces the residue-fill machinery + adds the wrap → strictly worse. Don't chase wrap-tile / Mod-Gather single-tile fill for this generator.
- **Orbit-max shifted-Max fill (technique #1656, task110 template) is hidden-UNSAFE here** (2026-06-08): `filled = Max over residue orbit via Gather-shift doubling` looks ~8888 cheap (9 planes, beats v29) and passes 266/266, BUT the 266 corpus has small holes; on 6000 FRESH ARC-GEN pairs the max residue-hole-run is 8 (vert) / 7 (horiz), and worst-case is ~10 (period-2 class size 11). Reach-3P (double-2) covers only run≤6 → r14 9-plane config fails 22/4000 fresh. A reach-SAFE orbit-max needs ≥12–18 shifted-Max planes (cover run-10 in both axes), costing ≥11010 (> v29 10592). LIVE's comb-conv-Div wins precisely because the comb covers the FULL residue class in 2 convs regardless of hole size — no reach assumption. Don't chase orbit-max for cost here.
- **Single-row period detection (LIVE/v28 uses row 14) fails ~0.5% of the generator distribution** (2026-06-08): row-14-only detection = 28/6000 wrong-period on fresh ARC-GEN; **2 lines [7,14] = 0/6000** (also 4 lines, all-rows = 0). v28 happens to score on the actual hidden set, but a future rebuild should use ≥2 detection lines for hidden safety (cheap; self-clamp OOB shift indices to the cell itself, NOT N−1, else the last p columns create false conflicts → sel=0).
- **True generator = UUID `0dfd9992` (`tasks.task_0dfd9992`), NOT the `task_*017*`/`task_d017b73f` files** (coincidental-hash RED HERRINGS, §FAMILY-LABEL). NG task017 = 17th ARC-AGI training UUID sorted alphabetically. **GENERATOR DECODE (ground truth):** `size=21` always; `mod=randint(4,9)`; `length=randint(4,mod)`; `offset=randint(1,length)`; pattern `color[row][col] = ((r*r+c*c) % mod)+1` with `r=(offset+row)%length - length//2` (same for c) → doubly-periodic with period `length` (∈{4..9}, so **period ≥ 4**; the "period 2" my detector reports on ~17% of samples is a coincidental sub-period). Colors `1..mod ⊆ 1..9` (0 only from holes). **Holes = exactly 5 black rectangles, each `wide∈[2,5] × tall∈[2,5]`, randomly placed (can overlap/merge).** Rule re-verified 0/266 vs numpy ref; vertical period == horizontal period on 266 + 6000 fresh.
- **Residue-MAX via U8 dilated MaxPool is infeasible** (2026-06-19, Worker-K): each of the 6 period-specific MaxPool instances (p=4..9) requires a separate Pad node because (a) SAME_UPPER auto_pad with dilations gives wrong output shape in ORT; (b) MaxPool pads attribute is banned (pads >= kernel_shape). The padding must be a multiple of p and large enough to cover all residue class cells: correct minimum pads are p=4→pad=12/45×45=2025B, p=5→pad=10/41×41=1681B, p=6→pad=12/45×45=2025B, p=7→pad=14/49×49=2401B, p=8→pad=16/53×53=2809B, p=9→pad=9/39×39=1521B. The 6 padded tensors total 12462B (all charged in value_info). Total lower bound ~19536B vs team-best 10153B: 1.93x worse. Smaller "incorrect" pads (e.g., k=6 pad=10 for p=4) fail 22% of seeds. No shared single pad exists. Do NOT attempt this approach.
- **Generator-confirmed reason orbit-max can't win** (2026-06-08, 50000 fresh): the 5 mergeable ≤5×5 cutouts produce a max residue-hole-run of **10** (period-2 cases: residue class has 11 cells, up to 10 holed). Reach-safe orbit-max therefore needs `double-3` (reach 7) on BOTH axes = 18 shifted-Max planes ≈ 13,943 — far above v30's 10,153. comb-conv-Div covers the full residue class in 2 convs regardless of run length, so it is the safe floor.
- **Comb-conv-Div memory floor ≈ 10000** (2026-06-08): the hidden-safe fill needs ~6 irreducible F16 [1,1,21,21] planes (lab16, nz16, comb2d, lab_sum, cnt_sum, avg) + f32 label crop (1764, conv on f32 input) + i8 pad tail (900) + detection. v29 already minimizes params (negpad label). The external `kmmmvs` 2510 is almost certainly NOT hidden-safe (same reach/overfit trap as orbit-max); do not treat 2510 as a reachable safe floor.
- **Averaged color index for fill**: Using Conv(color_idx, K)/Conv(occupancy, K) is fragile with
  floating-point precision and requires NaN handling.
